name: Prevention
description: Prevent waste rather than treating or cleaning it up after it has formed.

name: Atom Economy
description: Design syntheses so that most atoms of the starting materials become part of the final product.

name: Less Hazardous Synthesis
description: Use and generate substances with little or no toxicity to people and the environment.

name: Designing Safer Chemicals
description: Design chemical products to perform their function while reducing harmful effects.

name: Safer Solvents and Auxiliaries
description: Avoid solvents and auxiliaries where possible and choose safer ones when necessary.

name: Energy Efficiency
description: Minimize energy requirements and prefer ambient temperature and pressure when practical.

name: Renewable Feedstocks
description: Prefer renewable raw materials when technically and economically practical.

name: Reduce Derivatives
description: Avoid unnecessary protecting groups, temporary modifications and extra steps.

name: Catalysis
description: Prefer catalytic reagents over stoichiometric reagents when practical.

name: Design for Degradation
description: Design products that break down into harmless substances after use.

name: Real-Time Analysis
description: Develop monitoring methods that prevent formation of hazardous substances during processing.

name: Inherently Safer Chemistry
description: Choose substances and conditions that reduce accident risks such as fire, explosion and releases.
